 versus

Surajpur (C.G.)
 ... Respondent
Order Sheet 12/12/2024 Mr. Sushil Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant.
Mr. Kishan Lal Sahu, Dy. Govt. Advocate for the Respondent/ State.
Heard Call for the record of the trial Court.
Also heard on I.A. No. 01/2024 which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has filed the instant revision petition challenging the judgment dated 14.11.2024 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 20/2024 passed by learned First Additional Session Judge, Surajpur arising out of judgment dated 16.05.2024 passed in Criminal Case No. 1897/2022 by the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Surajpur whereby the applicant has been convicted as under:-
S.No Conviction Sentence 1. Under Section 420 of R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.
IPC 20,000/-, in default of payment of fine, further RI for 6 months.
2. Under Section 467 of R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.
IPC 20,000/-, in default of payment of fine, further RI for 6 months.

sentences.text:
3. Under Section 468 of R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.
IPC 20,000/-, in default of payment  of fine, further RI for 6 months.

All sentences shall run  concurrently Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the total period of sentence awarded to the applicant is of 3 years whereas he is in jail since 08/08/2022 and he has served the 02 years and 04 months of jail sentence.
The revision is of the year 2024 and final adjudication of the case will take its own time.
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case and also the period of incarceration by the applicant, he may be enlarged on bail..
On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes.

Considering the submission made by learned counsel for the parties, considering the nature of allegation and the evidence available on record further that the total period of sentence awarded to the applicant is of 03 years, out of which he already undergone the period of 02 years and 04 months, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

It is directed that the substantive jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing his personal bond for a sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety of the like some to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court for his appearance before the registry of this Court on 14/01/2025.

He shall thereafter, appear before the concerned trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to him till final disposal of this appeal.
List this case for final hearing.

Sd/-
(Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) Judge sagrika Mrigank @ Mrigang Kumar Sinha vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16008046/
